description: This file defines two classes, AzureQueueDataAdapterV1 and AzureQueueDataAdapterV2, which are data adapters for Azure Queue streaming in Orleans. They handle serialization and deserialization of stream data to and from queue messages, supporting different serialization versions for compatibility.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV1
classes.description: A data adapter handling serialization of Azure Queue stream data using a specific batch container type, maintaining backward compatibility.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV2
classes.description: A data adapter supporting custom serializers, designed for newer versions of Azure Queue stream data containers.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV1
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer for AzureQueueBatchContainer.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a queue message string from stream data, serializing it into a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Deserializes a queue message string into a batch container and sets its sequence token.

methods.name: IOnDeserialized.OnDeserialized
methods.description: Reinitializes the serializer after deserialization using dependency injection.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer for AzureQueueBatchContainerV2.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a queue message string from stream data, serializing it with support for newer types.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Deserializes a queue message string into a batch container and assigns a sequence token.

methods.name: IOnDeserialized.OnDeserialized
methods.description: Reinitializes the serializer after deserialization using dependency injection.
